annotations.title: Search FDA 510(k) & PMA Medical Device Clearances

description: Extract newly cleared FDA 510(k) premarket notifications and PMA Class III medical device approvals via openFDA with applicant domains, product codes, specialties, and review cycle days (`corridordata/fda-510k-medtech-device-clearances`).

maxItems.description: Maximum FDA device clearance records to return.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Optional per-run USD spend cap forwarded to Apify Pay-Per-Event billing (`maxTotalChargeUsd`).

recordTypes.description: FDA decision types to query (`510k` and/or `pma`).

name: search_fda_device_clearances
